## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (68%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged reliability, JPEG degradation, and a {Normal, Benign} conformal set warrant recut or deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 68%, Benign 31%, InSitu 1%, Invasive 0% [F1] | Favors Normal over Benign |
| Conformal set | {Normal, Benign} at 90% target (90% test coverage, n=132) | Cannot separate Normal from Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 32% reliability (flagged), 86th-percentile OOD, JPEG level 3 [F6] | Suspect degraded input; AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (84%–85%); contrast Benign (83%) [F5] | Reference neighbors match Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · High score (-1.70), but unreliable 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · High text score (-0.64, 18/20 spot check, caption-inconsistent) [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.38, 19/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Low score (+0.32, 12/20 spot check; Benign contrast) · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 9) · context · Mildly elevated (z=+0.50, 8/20 spot check; Benign contrast) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); top concept **Normal lobules** (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 JPEG degradation and 86th-percentile OOD shift obscure benign proliferation or atypia on this simulated frozen section.
- CONCH–MUSK disagreement, 31% Benign probability (Benign contrast `BACH_0384`), and disabled cell segmentation hide a benign lesion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 10, 1**: Inspect highest-risk heatmap tiles (59%, 32%, 16% risk) for stromal infiltration or artifact.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 6, 9, 11**: Verify normal two-layered lobules versus benign proliferation; confirm drafted recut or deeper levels.
3. **Regions 7, 11, 9**: Check lateral (100%) and inferior (97%) margin strips; suggested frozen-section margin call is defer [F7].
